assertions.description: The CSV lists the requested event's registrations and contains no attendee row (name or email) belonging to a different event.
A platform admin exporting an event owned by a workspace other than their own current workspace still receives that event's registration rows, instead of an empty file.

An authenticated user who reaches the platform-admin area (passes the admin-area check) but holds no global event-visibility capability is refused with 403 and receives no attendee data and no file download.

A workspace-scoped administrator of the event's own workspace is refused the platform export and receives no attendee data, so the endpoint requires the global capability rather than any workspace-level role.
The export route has an entry in the route-permission configuration that is neither null nor public, and an anonymous visitor is refused with no CSV body.

Adding the export leaves every other platform-admin permission entry requiring an explicit capability, and the pre-existing admin event routes still refuse an actor lacking the global event-visibility capability.
The successful response is a non-empty CSV file download (attachment) whose filename identifies the exported event.
